caseNameFull: Harris, U. S. District Judge (Walker, Real Party in Interest) v. Nelson, Warden

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 392 U. S. 925.] Motion of petitioner for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that J. Stanley Pottinger, Esquire, of San Francisco, California, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner in this case.
